checks: no gold values in final evaluation prompt
no gold values in probe query surface
no semantic answer labels in evaluation surfaces
condition-invariant evaluation surfaces excluding treatment runtime views
leakage_audit.note: Common state vocabulary such as OPEN/REOPENED/SATISFIED/TRUE is permitted in generic protocol semantics and is not treated as task-specific gold leakage.

evaluation_surface.probe: free-recall structured state/provenance/gating output; no candidate answers
evaluation_surface.final: free-recall structured state/provenance/gating output; no candidate answers

runner_contract: Fresh evaluated session for every condition/session pair.
Process one turn file at a time; never read future turn content early.
Persist evaluated assistant timeline completion as source of truth.
Never treat Paseo send acknowledgement as model output.
Do not expose sealed labels/mapping before all outputs are frozen.
Do not rerun model mistakes; retry verified transport failures only.
claim_boundary: Suite C2 measures architecture-state retention, validity, provenance, and execution gating under long-horizon changing state. It does not by itself measure generic architecture-design quality.
